title: goal_questions reads a goal research story's first question apart from the lead sentence before it
goal: bl_land.goal_questions splits a question from a preceding sentence that ends in a full stop, so a research story goal of the form new sprint writes (a lead sentence, then questions) names its first question alone and researched packs it alone (SP-ce5iig4g: ST-bg2kr4rw's first question was packed joined to the lead sentence and read weak; the orchestrator had to put a '; ' after the lead sentence to pass)
notes: Same defect with a colon lead-in, 2026-10-14: ST-xlr5flob's goal (as planned for every research story of SP-5dffnlxn) reads 'Answer with the kb tools first ... where no article fits: How do Amazon S3 conditional writes ...?'; the lead before ': ' is over QUESTION_LEAD_WORDS (8) words, so goal_questions keeps it and researched packed the first question joined to it: weak (20 of 25 key words; the lead's 'tools', 'official', 'kb-research', 'shared-state-concurrency' lack), while the question alone packs good. All eleven research stories of SP-5dffnlxn share this lead and will fail their first question the same way. Same defect, 2026-10-16, ST-cx7qhu3f (SP-xo45jvbj): its goal's first clause 'Research with the kb tools first and the live docs for gaps, written as kb facts and gap entries through /kb-research: (1) Which Claude Code parallel-work option ... ?' is read whole (lead over QUESTION_LEAD_WORDS and a numbered piece after the colon), so researched packs it with the lead's words: none, 'kb lacks: gaps, written, gap, entries, kb-research', while the question alone packs good (20 of 20 key words) over the new claude/parallel-sessions.md. The item's research is written and the other questions pass; this FAIL line stays until goal_questions drops the lead.
